mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assistant_messages ( conversation_id, sequence_number, role, content, tool_name, created_at ) SELECT #{conversationId}, COALESCE(MAX(sequence_number), 0) + 1, #{role}, #{content}, #{toolName}, #{createdAt} FROM assistant_messages WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT id, conversation_id, sequence_number, role, content, tool_name, created_at FROM assistant_messages WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY sequence_number DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) recent ORDER BY sequence_number ASC
